posts.text:
The United States is taking aim at Canada once again, with a crushing new set of tariffs.

Ultimately, government will need to solve this. But in the same way Canadians are avoiding US alcohol, produce, and other goods, they should get off US tech products too.

Luckily, I have a guide for that.
posts.summary: Criticizes US tariffs on Canada, advocates consumer boycott of US tech

posts.text: Meta might be denying wrongdoing, the acceptance of such a large fine and such wide-ranging changes for young users is a de facto admission imo.
posts.summary: Interprets Meta's fine acceptance as tacit admission of harm to young users

posts.text:
Not gonna lie, this feels like a pretty significant development.

Meta will “restrict teenagers' use of Facebook and Instagram ​to two hours a day and block all usage from midnight to 6 a.m.”

It will also “disable most push notifications to teenage users ​during school hours of 8 a.m. to 3 p.m.”
